title: Implement rollback, kill switch and operating documentation

checks.name: rebuild_cannot_enable_any_gate
checks.result: FeatureGate is rebuild-only and fail-closed. Shadow, Pilot, Canary, Production, unknown gate names, and external submission are all rejected. Missing, corrupt, or even synthetically valid future release control records resolve to current in Rebuild.

checks.name: rollback_manifest
checks.result: RollbackManifest binds only pre-existing read-only archive files, their SHA-256/size, retained vNext release evidence, retained commit IDs, and an explicit episode/scene scope. Path traversal, symlink traversal, duplicates, missing files, manifest tamper, archive drift, and evidence drift fail closed; source archive/evidence are not copied, deleted, or rewritten.

checks.name: kill_switch
checks.result: A single atomic vNext control-record replacement records current routing and the incident latch together. Kill switch requests are idempotent only for the same request ID; a different request cannot overwrite the original incident. There is no R3.1 clear or re-enable API, and v4 archive/vNext evidence remain unchanged.

checks.name: operations_complete
checks.result: The operations runbook states the rebuild-only scope, the unchanged real /mode-p-pilot entry, manual phase approvals, shadow isolation, rollback/kill-switch drill, forbidden manual edits, verification command, text/structural authority ceiling, and the separate Director-decision optimization boundary.

verification_results.name: r3_1_release_safety_suite
verification_results.result: 24 passed in 0.25s; 10 subtests passed. One environment-only pytest cache permission warning was emitted; no assertion failed.

director_decision_optimization.statement: The user-identified gap is documented as G-08 / INV-DIR-01 through INV-DIR-07. R3.1 does not claim to implement it; formal synchronization to the frozen construction plan and goal lock remains a subsequent controlled change after the R0-R3 repair queue.
